# `/controls` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /controls/v1

`listControlsV1` — List Compensating Controls

Returns a list of compensating controls associated with separation-of-duties policies.

- Scopes: idn:sod-control:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOD_CONTROL_ADMIN, SOD_POLICY_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.

  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: id: eq, in; name: eq, in, sw, co; type: eq; owner: eq, in; description: eq, in, sw, co; action: eq, in — e.g. `type eq "Mitigation" and name co "payroll"`
  - `sort` (query) — Sort results using the standard syntax described in [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters#sorting-results) Sorting is supported…
- Returns 200: array of compensatingcontrolresponse

### POST /controls/v1

`createControlV1` — Create Compensating Control

Creates a compensating control associated with separation-of-duties policies.

- Scopes: idn:sod-control:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOD_CONTROL_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): compensatingcontrolcreate
- Returns 201: compensatingcontrolresponse

### GET /controls/v1/{id}

`getControlV1` — Get compensating control by ID

Returns a single compensating control by ID.

- Scopes: idn:sod-control:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOD_CONTROL_ADMIN, SOD_POLICY_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The ID of the compensating control to fetch
- Returns 200: compensatingcontrolresponse

### PUT /controls/v1/{id}

`putControlV1` — Put Compensating Control

Updates the specified compensating control.

- Scopes: idn:sod-control:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOD_CONTROL_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The unique identifier of the Compensating Control to be updated.
- Body (application/json): compensatingcontrolupdate
- Returns 200: compensatingcontrolresponse

### DELETE /controls/v1/{id}

`deleteControlV1` — Delete compensating control by ID

Deletes the specified compensating control from the data store.

- Scopes: idn:sod-control:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — the ID (UUID) of the compensating control to delete.
- Returns 204: no body
